game.title: Los Angeles Rams at Washington Commanders

lede: Los Angeles Rams carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#7 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Washington Commanders +3.0 with a fair total of 48.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Los Angeles Rams run offence vs Washington Commanders run defence, which sits +0.129 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.

football_evidence.assessment: EdgeDesk’s number is 2.7 points closer to Washington Commanders than the line, and EdgeDesk cannot account for most of that.
